external_artifacts: fresh task-specific directory outside every repository/worktree; no home/profile/saves copied
not_authorized: C production UI or theme integration
new DEC/UIR or mechanics or numerical adoption
dependency upgrades/npm audit fix/new tools or billable APIs

verification.baseline: npm run check once on exact start SHA, recording actual scripts and outputs
verification.end: npm run validate:architecture + git diff/scope/protected-object and artifact checks; rerun full check only if justified, report what actually ran
verification.dependency_audit: readonly npm audit --json and --omit=dev plus actual dependency chains; no config changes
verification.failure_policy: preserve failure, do not broaden write scope; complete independent docs, report PARTIAL/BLOCKED where appropriate

stop: normal push only new governance branch; exact final SHA review; no automatic B/C/merge/release

model.mode: 普通/Standard（若客户端提供该区分）
model.basis: 上一批任务明确指定的模型；本轮范围为治理与只读诊断，不是新核心协议实现
model.fallback: 若当前客户端无该模型，保留当前实际可用编码模型并记录名称和档位；不自称实际配置已核验、不自动升级付费速度或 Ultra/Max
